chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ said to al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام:
What is the reward of one who trims from his moustache and clips his nails on every Jumuʿah?
He said: “He remains purified until the next Jumuʿah.”

key_terms.أَظْفَارَهُ: his nails, referring to clipping them
key_terms.ثَوَابُ: reward granted for an act of obedience
key_terms.شَارِبِهِ: his moustache, referring to grooming facial hair
key_terms.كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ: every Friday, indicating a regular weekly practice
key_terms.مُطَهَّرًا: purified, kept in a state of cleanliness

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for trimming the moustache and clipping the nails on Jumuʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that regularly trimming the moustache and clipping the nails on Jumuʿah carries the reward of remaining in a state of cleanliness until the following Jumuʿah. It highlights the Islamic emphasis on taharah (ritual purity) and personal grooming as part of the weekly etiquette associated with Friday.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.306 - Al-Hussain ibn Abi al-'Ala asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
'What is the reward for someone who trims their moustache and cuts their nails every Jumu’ah?'
Imam (as) replied: 'They will remain purified until the next Jumu’ah.'
